paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Tanchuma, Metzora 7, speaking in the name of ריב״ל; Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be R' Mana of Sha’av.[^1]

notes.text: The complete selected Torat Emet Tanchuma Metzora 7 scalar is a bounded nonmatch for Huna or Mana of Sha’av and the reported transmission. The new heading and personal titles therefore retain R' and the supplied ריב״ל remains unexpanded. Hyman’s scribal-error judgment and SHOULD READ correction remain explicitly attributed with their force; no printed correction history or Hebrew locator repair is claimed.
